depiction.primary_object: notched card or page outline with top-left corner cut
depiction.composition: single upright outlined card containing a centered down arrow

readings.meaning: save to SD card or memory card

ambiguity: Because the top-left corner is beveled without a fold crease, the outline is technically an SD/SIM card silhouette, though many viewers immediately read it as a generic document page with a download arrow.
